title: 天皇賞（秋）の後に・夕空に響く

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nice Nature gains more confidence after her performance in the autumn Tenno Sho. She aspires to compete in the Arima Kinen next.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After the race, Nice Nature happens upon Tokai Teio in the shopping district.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Teio recognizes Nice Nature as a powerful opponent, yet taunts her by saying that she cannot win unless she goes all out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the people in the shopping district urging her on after Teio's taunts, Nice Nature confidently declares that she'll win the Chunichi Shimbun Hai.
